name: Beary Bad End!
source:
You are a thief, looking to make big money off of some fancy technology. Luckily you've heard there's some tech in a random abandoned school building that could make you rich if you're able to find it!

However, you'll soon learn its home to a very devilish black and white bear...and he is very keen to make sure you never get out.

Will you escape, or will you be helpless to the cluthes of Monokuma?

[From [url=https://hollow-soul-stories.itch.io/beary-bad-end]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个小偷，想通过一些奇特的技术赚大钱。幸运的是，你听说在一栋废弃的校舍里有一些技术，如果你能找到它，可以让你致富！

然而，你很快就会发现这里住着一只非常邪恶的黑白熊……而且他非常想确保你永远不会出去。

你会逃跑，还是会在莫诺库玛的魔爪下无能为力？

[来自[url=https://hollow-soul-stories.itch.io/beary-bad-end]Itch.io[/url]]
